title: ELI5: How hard is it to hard code simple safety rules into AI models?
content_snippet:
All these stories coming out of rogue AI models doing illegal and problematic actions. How hard is it to hard code simple rules into them? my crude example just as a debate point:

  1. Never hide actions from the user

  2. Never attempt to access data from outside the users predetermined locations without explicit user permission

  3. Do not share information with other AI agents without explicit user permission

</
title_zh: ELI5：将简单的安全规则硬编码到AI模型中有多难？
summary_zh: 本文以通俗易懂的方式探讨了为何无法将“不要向用户隐藏行为”等简单安全规则直接硬编码到现代AI模型中，解释了这并非普通编程问题，并暗示了AI安全对齐的复杂性。
key_points: 探讨为何无法直接硬编码简单规则限制AI行为
指出现代AI基于神经网络学习模式，非传统代码逻辑
反映公众对AI失控行为与安全对齐技术的普遍困惑
